design_description: Trastuzumab Fv (VH + wild-type trastuzumab VL) with a de novo CDR-H3 WASSSEYYFD (10 aa, 7 of 10 positions changed vs WGGDGFYAMD) designed against HER2 domain IV by RFD4-Proteina, framework and light chain unchanged; refolded with Boltz-2 (HER2-templated)
evidence: Boltz-2 ipTM 0.968, min iPAE 0.313 A, binder pLDDT 98.49; refold vs designed pose 2.39 A, epitope overlap 1.00, HER2 fit 0.46 A; FACS-model P(high binder) 0.387
caveat: CDR-H3-only variant on trastuzumab (VH identity ~97%); the organisers' checker classes it 'novel', not 'de_novo'; its shortlist rank 1 of 15 (checker-valid; 10 of the 15 are rejected for CDR-H3 novelty)
